dashboard.subtitle: A calm place to find help, learn, and stay close to the people who can support you.
dashboard.help_now_description: Open a calm, three-step guide for the moment you're in.
dashboard.offline_title: Help Now and your Quick Guides work offline

help_now.title: What is happening?
help_now.subtitle: Pick the closest situation. You can always switch.
help_now.translation_pending_banner: These calm guides are still being translated. Showing in English for now.
help_now.breathe_caption: Breathe in for 4 · hold for 2 · breathe out for 6. Three rounds is usually enough.

disclaimer.title: A quick, calm note
disclaimer.emergency_strong: Hope is not an emergency service.
disclaimer.emergency_body: If you or your child is in danger, call your local emergency number now (112 in EU, 911 in US).
disclaimer.explainer: The strategies inside Help Now come from clinicians and parent organisations. They are gentle, general starting points — not personalised medical advice. Every child is different.
disclaimer.caveat_sources: Each strategy cites its sources (NICE, HAS, Autism France, peer-reviewed papers).
disclaimer.caveat_offline: Everything works offline — your phone doesn't need a signal.
disclaimer.caveat_stop: If a strategy doesn't feel right for your child, stop and try another.
disclaimer.caveat_specialist: Your specialist always knows your child better than any app.
disclaimer.acknowledge: I understand — show me Help Now
disclaimer.once_only: You'll only see this screen once.

onboarding.welcome_subtitle: A calm, private space for parents of autistic children. Get immediate help, find verified specialists, and read short practical guides — anytime.
onboarding.name_subtitle: Just for your personal greeting. No account needed yet.
